lessons.title: Nominalized Participles in Oblique Cases: Accusative, Dative, Ablative & Instrumental
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Embed entire propositional clauses as case-marked nominal arguments inside main clauses.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce the foundational morphosyntactic engine of B1 Mongolian complex sentence structure: fully nominalizing verbal participles (-сан/-даг/-х/-аагүй) and declining them in oblique cases: 1) Accusative -ыг (direct object clause: мэдэхийг хүсэх), 2) Dative -д (temporal/spatial locus: ирэхэд, болсонд), 3) Ablative -аас (causal/comparative origin: дууссанаас хойш, хэлснээс), and 4) Instrumental -аар (manner/means: бичсэнээр).
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Embed entire propositional clauses as case-marked nominal arguments inside main clauses.
lessons.audioPurpose: Demonstrate the phonological assimilation of case suffixes to participial stems (бичсэнийг, явсанд, хэлснээс, хийснээр).

grammarOverview.summary: Introduce the foundational morphosyntactic engine of B1 Mongolian complex sentence structure: fully nominalizing verbal participles (-сан/-даг/-х/-аагүй) and declining them in oblique cases: 1) Accusative -ыг (direct object clause: мэдэхийг хүсэх), 2) Dative -д (temporal/spatial locus: ирэхэд, болсонд), 3) Ablative -аас (causal/comparative origin: дууссанаас хойш, хэлснээс), and 4) Instrumental -аар (manner/means: бичсэнээр).
